name: stormcoder-android
description: Android shell for the Stormcoder Remote phone app. Self-contained: nothing outside this folder imports it, and the desktop app, relay and root npm scripts do not depend on it.

scripts.sync: npm run web && cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
